journal.claim.passage: A side passage exists beyond the workshop.
journal.claim.water: A boatman claims a singing spring offers water in the alcove.
journal.claim.dry_basin: The alcove basin is dry; its carved channel holds only dust.
journal.claim.riverbank: The river has a quiet reed bank and a deeper fishing channel.
